---
title: "UseReducedMotion"
description: "Returns true when the user or system prefers reduced motion (e.g., Windows \"Show animations\" is off, or SPI_GETCLIENTAREAANIMATION returns false). Automatically re-renders the component when the preference changes."
---

Use this to skip entrance/exit animations, disable pan inertia, terminate force-graph simulations immediately, and keep only ≤ 150 ms opacity fades (WCAG 2.3.3).

The value is seeded during the first render and then tracked live through `UISettings.AnimationsEnabledChanged`. That event needs Windows 10 2004 (19041); on older builds the preference is re-read whenever a theme or palette change arrives instead, so it updates on the next such notification rather than immediately.

```csharp
public bool UseReducedMotion()
```

Declared on [`RenderContext`](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/components/RenderContext).

**Learn more:** [Accessibility](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/guides/accessibility), [Animation](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/guides/animation), [Hooks](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/guides/hooks)

## Use from a class component [#use-from-a-class-component]

Class components can call the same hook directly. These overloads forward to the ones above:

```csharp
protected bool UseReducedMotion()
```
